title: SEBI Categorization and Rationalization of Mutual Fund Schemes
source: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
content: SEBI mandates strict categorization of mutual fund schemes into 5 broad groups: Equity, Debt, Hybrid, Solution-Oriented, and Other Schemes. Large Cap funds must invest at least 80% of total assets in top 100 companies by market capitalization. Mid Cap funds must invest at least 65% in 101st-250th companies, and Small Cap funds at least 65% in 251st company onwards. AMCs are permitted only one scheme per sub-category (except Index Funds and Sectoral/Thematic funds) to avoid investor confusion.
